name: Tanjiro Kamado
biography: A kind-hearted Demon Slayer who masters Sun Breathing and Water Breathing in an unyielding quest to cure his sister Nezuko and extinguish Muzan Kibutsuji's reign of terror.
quote: No matter how many people you may lose, you have no choice but to go on living.

name: Satoru Gojo
biography: The strongest Jujutsu Sorcerer of the modern era, wielding the Six Eyes and Limitless cursed technique with casual supremacy and deep devotion to his students.
quote: Throughout Heaven and Earth, I alone am the honored one.

name: Levi Ackerman
biography: Captain of the Survey Corps' Special Operations Squad, widely revered as humanity's strongest soldier capable of slicing through hordes of Titans in seconds.
quote: Give up on your dreams and die. Lead the recruits straight into hell.

name: Sung Jin-woo
biography: Originally known as humanity's weakest E-rank Hunter, he awakens through the mysterious System into the god-like Shadow Monarch, commanding endless shadow legions.
quote: Arise.

name: Frieren
biography: An elven mage who was part of the Hero Party that defeated the Demon King. Over a millennium old, she embarks on a quiet voyage to understand human emotion and time.
quote: It is because life is so short that human hearts are so gentle.

name: Raiden Shogun (Ei)
biography: The Electro Archon and ruler of Inazuma, Ei seeks Eternity through absolute stillness within the Plane of Euthymia, brandishing the devastating Musou no Hitotachi.
quote: Tear to shreds! The mortal world is but a shadow.

name: Cloud Strife
biography: An ex-SOLDIER 1st Class mercenary brandishing the Buster Sword, battling Shinra Electric Power Company and confronting the haunting phantom of Sephiroth.
quote: Stay where you belong... in my memories.

name: Malenia, Blade of Miquella
biography: An Empyrean demigod blessed with unalloyed gold prosthetic limbs and cursed by the Scarlet Rot, who has never known defeat in combat.
quote: I am Malenia, Blade of Miquella. And I have never known defeat.

name: Acheron
biography: A Galaxy Ranger and Emanator of Nihility wandering the cosmos with a scabbard she only draws when severing destiny itself under the black hole's red gaze.
quote: I weep for the departed... their sorrow shall be extinguished in rain.

name: Johnny Silverhand
biography: Legendary rockerboy, charismatic frontman of Samurai, and rebellious iconoclast living on a biochip inside mercenary V's neural network.
quote: Wake the f*** up, Samurai. We have a city to burn.

name: Miles Morales
biography: Brooklyn's teenage Spider-Man who defies the Multiverse's canon events, mastering Venom Strike bio-electricity and camouflage to save everyone.
quote: Everyone keeps telling me how my story is supposed to go. Nah. Imma do my own thing.

name: Paul Atreides
biography: Ducal heir of House Atreides who drinks the Water of Life, unites the Fremen fedaykin, and unleashes holy war across the known universe as Muad'Dib.
quote: Lead them to Paradise.

name: Bruce Wayne / Batman
biography: In his second year as Gotham's vigilante, Bruce Wayne investigates the Riddler's corruption ring and transitions from a tool of vengeance to a symbol of hope.
quote: I am vengeance. I am the night.

name: Tony Stark / Iron Man
biography: Genius, billionaire, playboy, philanthropist who forged the Iron Man armor and made the ultimate sacrifice with the Infinity Gauntlet to restore half the universe.
quote: And I... am... Iron Man.

name: J. Robert Oppenheimer
biography: Theoretical physicist and director of the Los Alamos Laboratory during the Manhattan Project, burdened by the moral fallout of unleashing atomic fire.
quote: Now I am become Death, the destroyer of worlds.

name: Eleven (Jane Hopper)
biography: A girl raised in Hawkins National Laboratory with telekinetic and psychic capabilities who repeatedly closes the gate to the Upside Down to protect her friends.
quote: Friends don't lie.

name: Jinx (Powder)
biography: A manic Zaunite inventor and marksman armed with Fishbones and Pow-Pow, torn between traumatic childhood memories and her destructive chaotic identity.
quote: I'm not crazy! I'm just ahead of the curve.

name: Joel Miller
biography: A hardened black-market smuggler surviving twenty years in post-apocalyptic quarantine zones who discovers paternal redemption while escorting Ellie across America.
quote: No matter what, you keep finding something to fight for.

name: Daemon Targaryen
biography: The Rogue Prince of Dragonstone, rider of the blood wyrm Caraxes, and wielder of Dark Sister whose ambition sparks the devastating Targaryen civil war.
quote: Dreams didn't make us kings. Dragons did.

name: Geralt of Rivia
biography: A mutated monster hunter of the School of the Wolf wielding silver and steel blades, bound by Destiny to Princess Cirilla of Cintra.
quote: Evil is evil. Lesser, greater, middling, it's all the same.

name: RM (Kim Nam-joon)
biography: Leader and main rapper of 21st-century pop icons BTS. A philosophically profound lyricist, composer, and UN speaker advocating youth empowerment.
quote: Find your name, find your voice by speaking yourself.

name: Jennie Kim
biography: Main rapper and lead vocalist of BLACKPINK, global Chanel house ambassador, and fashion powerhouse renowned for her charismatic stage aura.
quote: Bitch, I'm a star, but not Patrick.

name: Hanni Pham
biography: Vietnamese-Australian vocalist and dancer of NewJeans known for sweet vocals, writing lyrics on 'Hype Boy' and 'OMG', and bright youthful energy.
quote: Music is something that brings people together without needing any translation.

name: Bang Chan
biography: Leader, producer, and mentor of Stray Kids and 3RACHA, orchestrating self-produced chart-topping anthems with limitless creative passion.
quote: Stray Kids everywhere all around the world. You make Stray Kids stay.

name: Huh Yunjin
biography: Korean-American vocalist, acoustic songwriter, and former classical opera trainee dedicated to dismantling idols' conventional stereotypes.
quote: I want to change the idol industry.

name: Peter Parker (Spider-Man)
biography: The definitive web-slinging hero of Marvel Comics who learns through tragic loss that with great power there must also come great responsibility.
quote: With great power comes great responsibility.

name: Wolverine (Logan)
biography: Mutant brawler laced with an unbreakable Adamantium skeleton and regenerative healing factor, fighting for Xavier's dream of mutant equality.
quote: I'm the best there is at what I do, but what I do best isn't very nice.

name: The Joker
biography: The Clown Prince of Crime, Batman's eternal psychological antithesis who seeks to prove that one bad day can reduce anyone to sheer madness.
quote: All it takes is one bad day to reduce the sanest man alive to lunacy.

name: Mark Grayson (Invincible)
biography: Son of Omni-Man who inherits Viltrumite superhuman flight and strength, enduring brutal cosmic wars to safeguard Earth from galactic conquests.
quote: I'll still have you, Dad.

name: Dream of the Endless (Morpheus)
biography: The Lord of Dreams and ruler of the Dreaming, an anthropomorphic personification of story, fantasy, and slumber spanning trillions of years.
quote: Things need not have happened to be true. Tales and dreams are the shadow-truths that will endure.

name: Monkey D. Luffy
biography: Captain of the Straw Hat Pirates and the reincarnation of Sun God Nika (Joy Boy), sailing across the Grand Line to discover the One Piece and attain absolute freedom.
quote: I'm gonna be King of the Pirates!

name: Guts (The Black Swordsman)
biography: A branded struggler wielding the massive Dragonslayer blade, defying demonic Apostles and the God Hand with indomitable human rage and unyielding will.
quote: He who acts under destiny without fighting is not a human being. Struggle, contend, wriggle!

name: Denji (Chainsaw Man)
biography: A hybrid Devil Hunter who fused with his Chainsaw Devil dog Pochita, pulling the ripcord in his chest to sprout whirling blades from his skull and limbs.
quote: If there is such a thing as a happy life, it's about being able to eat jam with bread!

name: Anya Forger
biography: A telepathic orphan girl adopted by spy Twilight and assassin Thorn Princess who uses mind reading to secretly maintain world peace and gather Stella Stars.
quote: Waku waku!

name: Yoichi Isagi
biography: An analytical football striker who awakens spatial awareness and Meta-Vision within the ruthless Blue Lock project to become the world's most lethal egotist.
quote: I am the protagonist of this field!
